limits: Alternate compositions of named entries only. No elements package or workspace source aliases.
Native semantic and computed-style scenarios only; manual AT, native clipboard transport, SSR/hydration and full theme visual acceptance remain separate.

runtime.policy: Locally resolved browser installations and executable bytes; no inference from package version alone.

earlierAttempts.boundary: 109 passed/23 failed. Portable feedback imposed swatch host width; example loading field shadowed its reactive accessor; reconnection did not restart timer work; timeout expectations ignored deliberate focus pause.

Preparation generated the expected changed customization coverage, triggering source/retained-metadata stability protection before browsers. Reviewed the coverage diff and explicitly regenerated metadata before run03.

limitations: Seven entries have named-scenario qualification, not every export or owning-element feature.
Admission priority does not own DOM order, timeouts, announcements, focus, swipe gestures or persistence; the example supplies those policies where exercised.
The existing swatch suite intentionally skips its detailed forced-color sample assertion in Firefox/WebKit;25 passes do not include those two cases.
Physical touch/IME, native AT speech, retail browsers, other OS/device conditions, full SSR/hydration and separate-owner acceptance remain open.
The other37 of110 public inventory entries remain pending. Historical external CSS-authoring rerun is retired, never passed.
